_comment: godot-mcp client registration examples. Replace <GODOT_MCP_HOME> and <GODOT_EXE> with local values (see ../README.md placeholder legend). GODOT_PATH is set as a persistent user env var, but including it here is more robust (some clients sanitize env).
_runtime_tools_reminder: game_* tools need mcp_interaction_server.gd registered as the McpInteractionServer autoload in the Godot project (Project > Project Settings > Autoload). Source: <GODOT_MCP_HOME>/build/scripts/mcp_interaction_server.gd
